'''D-baffling''' was a system that eliminated extraneous sound. Theaters such as the [[Estuan Theater]] aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] were equipped with D-baffling.
